note: Re-judged 2026-10-19 (independent auditor, after 8d18d4c4c3). The earlier not-applicable verdict rested on the owner's 2026-10-11 decline of the type-13 SRv6 form; 8d18d4c4c3 records the owner's reversal, implements the form and removes the {feature-declined} annotation, so no_code_path no longer holds. RFC 9830 Section 2.4.2: "Length:  Specifies the length of the value field (i.e., not including Type and Length fields) in terms of octets.  The value MUST be 18 when a SRv6 BSID is present, 6 when an SR-MPLS BSID is present, or 2 when no BSID is present." Producer: srpolicy/config.go::buildBindingSIDSRv6SubTLV, reached from parseConfigRoute via 'binding-sid srv6 <ipv6-address>' (buildTunnelEncap writes at most one type-13 sub-TLV); receive rendering srpolicy/attr_json.go::bindingSIDToJSON reads type 13 by length (2, 6, 18, else malformed). TestRFC9830BindingSIDSRv6Encode asserts the whole Tunnel Encapsulation TLV octet for octet (0d12 0000 + 16-octet SID); its negative tag (SR-MPLS written at Length 6) shows 18 is not a constant but strictly exercises the neighbouring RFC9830-2.4.2-4 form. TestRFC9830BindingSIDSRv6Decode asserts a Length-18 sub-TLV renders as the SRv6 SID and a Length-20 one carrying the same 16 octets is malformed and never an SRv6 SID, a genuine violating input of this row. Overlay mutants (tags ze_core ze_bgp): encoder writes Length 16 (Encode red); decoder accepts any length >= 18 as SRv6 (Decode red); decoder rejects 18 (Decode red). All killed. Note: when 'binding-sid mpls' and 'binding-sid srv6' are both configured the MPLS form silently wins (Section 2.4.2 single-instance rule); not this row.
